fields.label: Post Header
fields.name: post_header
fields.instructions: Thumbnail for cards, search, Trending, and related posts (and fallback for the main page if Post page hero is empty). Do not crop this media file in the library if it is reused elsewhere — use "Post page hero" for main-page-only crops.

fields.label: Post page hero (main article only)
fields.name: post_hero
fields.instructions: Optional image for the main post page only. Crop or replace freely — this does NOT change search, cards, Trending, or related-post thumbnails. Prefer a separate file or Media Library "Save as copy" so the shared thumbnail (Post Header / Video Thumbnail) stays untouched.

fields.instructions: Thumbnail for video cards, search, Trending, and related posts (and fallback for the main page if Post page hero is empty). Do not crop this shared media file for the article header — use "Post page hero" for main-page-only crops.
